title: DESCRIPTION
source:
*EXAMINATION WORKS*

* Formatted the MATHS question paper for grade 1 & 2 for the POMT Exams

* Given the Grade X Marksheet certificate to the student.(ID-2179, 3802)

* Distributed the answer-copy bundles to the teacher to distribute to the students for the Mid-Term Exam.

* Collected the same number of answer-copy bundles from the teacher.

* Uploaded & updated the student's (Birth, caste & Transfer certificate) on the Eduletics portal.

*OTHER WORKS*

* Dispersal Duty.

* Bus Duty & Scanning (R-59)

* Collected notebooks from the following classes:
* 5 DELTA [SANSKRIT]
* 5 OMEGA [ICT]
* 6 SIGMA [HINDI]
* 7 IOTA [SANSKRIT]
* 7 IOTA [PHYSICS]
* 7 SIGMA [SANSKRIT]
* 8 IOTA [MATHS]
* 8 OMICRON [SANSKRIT]
* 8 SIGMA [MATHS]
* 8 ZETA [SST]

* Collected homework feedback from the first-floor classes and shared it via a Google Form.

* Prepared the Biometric attendance record of Teaching, Non-Teaching, Admin, Transport, Guard and 4th grade employee given by Principal Sir.
